functions.name: Govern
functions.title: GOVERN
functions.outcome: The organization's cybersecurity risk management strategy, expectations, and policy are established, communicated, and monitored

functions.name: Identify
functions.title: IDENTIFY
functions.outcome: The organization's current cybersecurity risks are understood

functions.name: Protect
functions.title: PROTECT
functions.outcome: Safeguards to manage the organization's cybersecurity risks are used

functions.name: Detect
functions.title: DETECT
functions.outcome: Possible cybersecurity attacks and compromises are found and analyzed

functions.name: Respond
functions.title: RESPOND
functions.outcome: Actions regarding a detected cybersecurity incident are taken

functions.name: Recover
functions.title: RECOVER
functions.outcome: Assets and operations affected by a cybersecurity incident are restored

categories.name: Organizational Context
categories.outcome: The circumstances - mission, stakeholder expectations, dependencies, and legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements - surrounding the organization's cybersecurity risk management decisions are understood

categories.name: Risk Management Strategy
categories.outcome: The organization's priorities, constraints, risk tolerance and appetite statements, and assumptions are established, communicated, and used to support operational risk decisions

categories.name: Roles, Responsibilities, and Authorities
categories.outcome: Cybersecurity roles, responsibilities, and authorities to foster accountability, performance assessment, and continuous improvement are established and communicated

categories.name: Policy
categories.outcome: Organizational cybersecurity policy is established, communicated, and enforced

categories.name: Oversight
categories.outcome: Results of organization-wide cybersecurity risk management activities and performance are used to inform, improve, and adjust the risk management strategy

categories.name: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management
categories.outcome: Cyber supply chain risk management processes are identified, established, managed, monitored, and improved by organizational stakeholders

categories.name: Asset Management
categories.outcome: Assets (e.g., data, hardware, software, systems, facilities, services, people) that enable the organization to achieve business purposes are identified and managed consistent with their relative importance to organizational objectives and the organization's risk strategy

categories.name: Risk Assessment
categories.outcome: The cybersecurity risk to the organization, assets, and individuals is understood by the organization

categories.name: Improvement
categories.outcome: Improvements to organizational cybersecurity risk management processes, procedures and activities are identified across all CSF Functions
